question: Where is the breath-filled vital air said to be situated within living beings?
premises: The vital air fills with breath
This air is present in living beings
It is situated in all beings
inference: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam (neuter singular) with vāyuḥ (masculine) is syntactically unusual.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
